_case: Best case: hospice-run, loss-specific, richly detailed, source page is live and specific. This is what a high-quality record looks like and what the ingest pipeline should aim for.
name: Loss of a Child Support Group
description: An ongoing peer group for parents who have experienced the death of a child of any age. Open to the community regardless of whether the child was a patient.
accessibility_notes: Ground floor, free parking, wheelchair accessible

_case: Messy but publishable: church-hosted, secular in practice, cost not stated. Note cost=unknown renders as 'Cost not listed — ask when you call', never as Free. Note faith_affiliation=christian but faith_participation_required=false — that distinction is the whole reason the field pair exists.
name: Wednesday Evening Grief Group
description: A weekly drop-in group open to anyone in the community who has experienced a loss. Hosted by the church; attendance does not require church membership.
internal_notes: Source page mentions the group but gives no cost or registration info. Call to confirm before promoting to source_verified.

_case: Online, high-sensitivity loss type, claimed by the organization. org_confirmed is the only tier that requires a human on the other end — note last_confirmed_by_org is set, which source_verified records never have.
name: Online Suicide Loss Support Community
organization: Alliance of Hope for Suicide Loss Survivors
description: A moderated online community for people who have lost someone to suicide, available at any hour and staffed by trained moderators.
schedule_text: Available 24/7; moderated forum plus scheduled video groups
